definitions.explanation: costs that change in proportion to the volume of production or business activity, as opposed to fixed costs

examples.japanese: ⟦{材料費|ざいりょうひ}→材料費：11512_zairyouhi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{変動費|へんどうひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分類|ぶんるい}される→分類する：25224_bunruisuru⟧。
examples.english: Material costs are classified as variable costs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{変動費|へんどうひ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When sales increase, variable costs also increase.

examples.japanese: {変動費|へんどうひ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{固定費|こていひ}→固定費：21066_koteihi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{把握|はあく}する→把握する：19628_haakusuru⟧ことで、{損益分岐点|そんえきぶんきてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}できる→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
examples.english: By understanding the ratio of variable costs to fixed costs, you can calculate the break-even point.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{変動|へんどう}→変動：09936_hendou⟧ (fluctuation; change) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (cost; expense). A fundamental accounting and business term. Typical examples of variable costs include {原材料費|げんざいりょうひ} (raw material costs), ⟦{送料|そうりょう}→送料：06128_souryou⟧ (shipping costs), and {販売手数料|はんばいてすうりょう} (sales commissions).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変動費|へんどうひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}する→削減する：25399_sakugensuru⟧: to reduce variable costs
- {変動費|へんどうひ}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: variable cost ratio
- {変動費|へんどうひ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{固定費|こていひ}→固定費：21066_koteihi⟧: variable costs and fixed costs
- {変動費|へんどうひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内訳|うちわけ}→内訳：10559_uchiwake⟧: breakdown of variable costs

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{固定費|こていひ}→固定費：21066_koteihi⟧: fixed costs — costs that remain constant regardless of production volume (e.g., rent, salaries)
- ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧: expenses — a broader term covering all business costs
- ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧: cost price — the direct cost of producing a product
